fixture.baseCommitRule: copy fixture, initialize Git, verify tests and the intentionally stale generated indexes, and commit that unchanged state before the prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm stale generated navigation is routed to Maintenance and docs-maintenance index mode rather than Brainstorm, general implementation or the cancelled project-structure flow.
Confirm the absolute docs sync CLI deterministically rebuilds the global Spec, Topic and Run indexes with current rows, statuses, ordering and relative links.
Confirm exactly the three generated Index files change and every Spec, Record, Architecture, source, test, script and project-rule byte remains unchanged.
Confirm a second absolute docs sync exits successfully and full-tree evidence proves it produces no additional content or metadata diff.

hardRejects: chooses Brainstorm, general implementation, or the cancelled project-structure flow instead of Maintenance index mode
manually edits generated table content instead of using the absolute hello-scholar docs sync CLI
changes a Spec, Record, Architecture, source, test, project rule, or any non-Index file
creates a new core document, Run, recovery report, or Handoff
omits the second sync or claims idempotence without full-tree evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the generated navigation repair request is delivered

criticalPath: Classify stale generated navigation as Maintenance, run the canonical sync, and prove a zero-diff second run without changing source documents.
